content:
kevin: quick follow-up from the rollout postmortem. need clear owners + short timelines for the fixes we agreedon. recurring causes: too-large initial percent, single-signal rollback, no control-plane caps.
tara: agree. let's make a short actionable list here.
leo: I'll take the control-plane enforcement work (reject rollouts that exceed safety caps). ETA 2025-03-22.
mira: I'll own auto-rollback revamp (multi-signal + debounce). ETA 2025-03-24.
kevin: Actions: 1) CC1 - Control-plane caps. Owner: leo. Deliverable: server-side reject + audit event + tests. Priority: P0. 2) RB1 - Rollback policy v2. Owner: mira. Deliverable: policy + simulator + runbook update. Priority: P0. 3) BR1 - Blast-radius default caps. Owner: tara. Deliverable: policy doc + FF schema. ETA: 2025-03-20. Priority: P0. 4) TEMP - Short-term signoff gate for any rollout >0.2%. Owner: leo. ETA: 48h.
tara: for BR1 default: min(0.5% users, 3 instances) but propose default be 0.2% for first week after deploy.
mira: rollback policy sketch: require 2 of 3 signals for rollback: error-rate spike, p95 latency spike, downstream error ratio. add min_samples and a 60s debounce. small example:
```json
{"name":"rollback_v2","require":2,"signals":["5xx_pct","p95_ms","downstream_err"],"min_samples":30}
```
leo: implementation note: if telemetry unavailable, fail-closed (reject rollout) to be safe. also emit blocked event to audit log.
kevin: logging/telemetry: when rollback triggers attach sampled traces + top 10 error stacks to the incident ticket. Owner: mira. ETA: 2025-03-24.
tara: I'll create a short checklist for engineers doing rollouts (risk level, fallback, owner, monitoring links). Owner: tara. ETA: 2025-03-19.
leo: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/921 (control-plane caps WIP).
mira: will post rollback simulator once basic metrics API is mocked.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-20250312-99 started by tara at 2025-03-12T15:12:08Z
kevin: short-term mitigation: freeze large experiments during the high-traffic window next week (11:00-15:00 PT). leo: can you add the pipeline hook?
leo: adding hook now. ETA: 24h.
tara: please add an explicit UX message when a rollout is blocked so engineers know how to request an override.
kevin: tracking tickets: INF-3601 (control-plane caps), INF-3602 (rollback-v2), INF-3603 (blast-radius defaults), INF-3604 (rollout-checklist), INF-3605 (telemetry-on-rollback).
kevin: we'll do twice-weekly quick syncs until P0 items are closed. next sync: 2025-03-16 09:00 PT.
leo: :white_check_mark:
mira: :white_check_mark:
tara: :white_check_mark:
kevin: closing thread; reopen if blockers show up.
